primary_endpoint: Histological response at 12 months and ALT levels at 3 and 6 months.
efficacy_outcome: Histological response: placebo 18, EPA-E 1800 mg/day 18, and 2700 mg/day 20 participants; trend-test p=0.57. ALT change at 3 months was −19.3 U/L with placebo, −3.0 with 1800 mg/day (p=0.0137), and +2.8 with 2700 mg/day (p=0.0006); at 6 months, changes were −19.1, −9.5 (p=0.1592), and −3.0 U/L (p=0.0153), respectively.
safety_signal: Serious adverse events affected 4/75 participants on placebo, 8/82 on EPA-E 1800 mg/day, and 5/86 on EPA-E 2700 mg/day; deaths were not reported.
